checks.semanticReview: see forwarding-alternative-review.json; The source forwards input to the bytes slot of _convert and copies it with setRange. Both stock alternatives instead follow input length, size/header allocation and setRange argument effects; the only difference is the allocation temporary. They are size/position detours, not byte-content traces (DART-FLOW-003). The byte model retains direct input-to-bytes forwarding.

see forwarding-alternative-review.json; The source copies bytes into the returned list. Both retained routes depend on conservative setRange cross-argument effects and revisit _convert through selected convert/add/addSlice callers. This does not prove arbitrary caller ordering, exact buffer contents or slot independence; the byte model bounds allocation and setRange effects (DART-FLOW-003).
